Kritika

📞 8860191655 						

krikarnal@gmail.com

Professional Summary	

A dedicated and results-driven IT professional with over 13 years of experience as a Tech Lead and Java Developer. Adept at leading and mentoring technical teams, with hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Microservices, DevOps, MySQL, Postgres, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Kafka, and Git repositories.

Proficient in Agile methodology and experienced in utilizing tools such as Jira.

Managed projects using Agile Scrum Methodology and practices such as test-driven development and continuous integration.

Worked extensively with development teams to architect and produce appropriate design artifacts/solutions to meet business requirements.

Developed and reviewed code in Java and Spring Boot, ensuring adherence to coding standards.

Strong understanding of Core Java, OOP Concepts, Collections Framework, Exception Handling, I/O System, Multi-Threading, Serialization, and JDBC.

Hands-on experience in creating Web Services, RESTful APIs, XML, and JSON.

Good hands-on experience on SQL and NoSQL databases like Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, and DynamoDB.

Extensive experience in using Hibernate ORM with annotations, and in configuring and integrating Spring with Hibernate for database transaction handling.

Experience in developing reports using JasperReports with IReport Designer and JasperSoft Studio.

Experienced in developing multi-tiered web applications and managing source control using GIT and SVN.

Extensively used Gradle and Maven for managing dependencies and building applications.

Experienced in setting up and running Deployment pipelines for Dev, Test, Stage, and Prod regions.

Proficient in utilizing IDEs such as Eclipse, Spring Tool Suite, and IntelliJ.

Strong analytical skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements.



Technical Skills

Category Details Frameworks Spring Boot, Hibernate, EJB, Kafka, AWS, Concourse Web Development Angular, React, Spring Boot, Java/J2EE, JSP, Microservices, API Gateway, JDBC, CSS, HTML, XML, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, jQuery SDLC Agile-Scrum, Waterfall Design Patterns Factory, Singleton Source Control GitHub, SVN, Git Repositories, Git Bash App & Web Servers Apache Tomcat, JBoss, Wildfly10 Databases MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB, PL/SQL Tools Eclipse, IntelliJ, STS, Sonar, JUnit5, Jaspersoft, Postman, Jira Reporting Technologies Jasper Reports Platforms Windows, Linux

Professional Experience

Tata Consultancy Services | Project: Pet Insurance_PPAPI

Role: Java Developer | Duration: October 2023 – Present

Responsibilities:

Developed and integrated business logic services with thorough test coverage.

Developed REST APIs from scratch that interact with third-party systems or databases.

Implemented caching using AWS DynamoDB, resulting in significant improvement in API response time.

Coordinated with the Salesforce team to integrate APIs and improve performance.

Implemented security using JWT tokens for authorized users.

Conducted API testing with Postman, verifying endpoints and validating response data.

Implemented Kafka consumers and producers to streamline data flow and enhance system integration.



Established automated CI/CD pipelines using Concourse on GitHub, utilizing Docker for consistent build and deployment processes.

Configured GitHub Actions for pipeline workflows and actively involved in the deployment setup process in Harness.

Provided production release support and led Program Increment planning for the team.

Experienced Jira user, created Jira dashboards and stories to reflect estimated work.

Collaborated with senior management and the Scrum Master to prioritize project initiatives.

Presented System Demos and communicated with upstream/downstream teams to fulfill requirements before release deadlines.

Created DOUs (Document of Understanding) for all services and provided knowledge transfer to the production support team.

Environment: Eclipse, JDK 17, Springboot, Kafka, Github, Postman, Jira, Junit, SonarCube, Concourse, Harness, Rancher, AWS, MySQL, DynamoDB

Tata Consultancy Services | Project: PET EVB

Role: Full Stack Engineer | Duration: August 2022 – September 2023

Responsibilities:

Collaborated closely with senior management and the Scrum Master to identify and prioritize project initiatives.

Provided technical guidance and mentorship to team members and created documentation for knowledge transfer.

Developed Microservices to provide RESTful APIs utilizing Spring Boot with data persistence frameworks like JDBC Template.

Implemented a Kafka listener application using the Spring Boot framework.

Developed Microservices that communicate with Salesforce APIs.

Handled software dependencies using Apache Maven.

Built multiple backend components through REST, Spring Boot, and a multi-layered architecture (Repositories, Services, Controllers, DAO classes).

Used Google’s GSON and Jackson Core to handle JSON and RESTful services.

Designed RESTful APIs with Swagger and third-party tools.

Used JUnit and Mockito for developing tests and mock services.

Used GIT for version control and code reviews.

Created and monitored Change Requests for production promotions.

Updated database tables as needed and presented System Demos.



Environment: Eclipse, JDK 17, Springboot, Kafka Listener, Github, Gson, Angular, Jira

Global Logic | Project: AirBase

Role: Java Developer | Duration: May 2022 – July 2022

Responsibilities:

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Implemented a File Upload API for role-based users to upload files to a dedicated path.

Implemented a File Download API with access control.

Implemented and maintained unit and integration tests for services.

Used JIRA and Confluence to communicate status and estimates to project leads and analysts.

Environment: IntelliJ, Java11, Postgres, Git Repositories, Microservices

Altran | Project: IBM Spectrum Scale

Role: Java Developer | Duration: August 2020 – July 2022

Responsibilities:

Gathered requirements and assisted with analysis and design document creation.

Performed technical oversight and assessment of application and system development projects using Agile methodology.

Implemented an API that communicates with the client side.

Developed front-end screens using DOJO and integrated them with the API.

Used Ajax calls to refresh real-time data on front-end pages.

Environment: Java, Microservices, Spring Boot, Postgres, Dojo, RTC

Libsys Ltd. | Project: Financial Accounting

Role: Technical Lead | Duration: June 2019 – August 2020

Responsibilities:

Performed technical oversight and assessment of application and system development projects using Agile methodology.

Interacted with customers to understand their ledgers and implemented a utility to load customer data, which extensively reduced manual effort.

Designed, Developed, Tested, and implemented the end-to-end front-end and back-end architecture.



Deployed Liquibase database changes to various environments inside Wildfly.

Used JasperReports for various complex reports.

Created history and balance sheet logic for ledgers.

Configured and used Log4J for logging.

Extensively used SQL in constructing views and checking transaction counts.

Environment: Java 8, Hibernate, Log4J, JasperReports, Postgres9, LSUI (GWT)

Libsys Ltd. | Project: LS Classroom

Role: Sr. Java/J2EE Developer | Duration: September 2017 – May 2019

Responsibilities:

Performed technical oversight and assessment of application and system development projects.

Designed and administered a database for classroom use.

Developed REST APIs that consumed data from other applications and provided it to front-end Angular calls.

Developed PUT and POST APIs to ensure accurate system logic.

Developed unit tests using JUnit.

Used JasperReports for reporting with XML report templates.

Configured and used Log4J for logging.

Used Swagger to document APIs.

Environment: SpringBoot, Angular, STS, Tomcat 8.0, GIT, Gradle, JasperReports, Log4J

Libsys Ltd. | Project: LSAcademia_Mobile Application

Role: Sr. Software Engineer | Duration: September 2016 – November 2017

Responsibilities:

Performed technical oversight and assessment of application and system development projects.

Developed endpoints using SOAP for mobile applications.

Integrated with Google Airbase server to send user notifications and built a dedicated notification server.

Implemented automated attendance using Beacons for both Android and iOS apps.

Directly interacted with designers for UI/UX of mobile apps.

Used GSON and ObjectMapper to convert objects into JSON and vice versa.

Environment: Eclipse, SOAP, Maven, Java 8, Servlet



Libsys Ltd. | Project: LSAcademia_College and School ERP

Role: Software Engineer | Duration: July 2012 – August 2016

Responsibilities:

Developed the application using Agile methodology and worked closely with architects, developers, and business analysts.

Performed technical oversight and assessment of application and system development projects.

Implemented back-end logic in EJBs and later migrated them to Hibernate.

Developed front-end web pages using JSP, JavaScript, HTML5, Tiles, CSS, and Bootstrap.

Developed unit tests using JUnit.

Created Use Case, Sequence, and Class diagrams using Microsoft Visio.

Implemented continuous integration using Jenkins.

Extensively used SQL and PL-SQL for views, indexes, stored procedures, triggers, and more.

Designed reports using JasperReports with XML report templates.

Environment: JSP, EJB, Hibernate, JavaScript, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML5, SQL, Eclipse, Linux, SVN, JasperReports, Log4j, Jenkins, Jboss

Education & Credentials

B.Tech in Computer Science, ITM University, Gurgaon — 2012 Score: 77%
